verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Quo acting only as an MCP server, exposing its conversations, contacts and calls to external agents like Claude and ChatGPT. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Quo, or its Sona AI agent, connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
